+    def add_alias(self, alias: str, target: str) -> None:
+        """Add an alias that maps a template name to another template name.
+
+        :param alias: The alias name to create
+        :param target: The actual template name to load
+        """
+        self._aliases[alias] = target
+
+    def remove_alias(self, alias: str) -> None:
+        """Remove an alias. Safe to call with nonexistent aliases.
+
+        :param alias: The alias name to remove
+        """
+        self._aliases.pop(alias, None)
+
+    def _resolve_alias(self, template: str) -> str:
+        """Resolve a template name through aliases. Does not chain.
+
+        :param template: The template name (possibly an alias)
+        :return: The resolved template name
+        """
+        return self._aliases.get(template, template)
